query: For the paper "Different Absorption from the Same Sharing: Sifted Multi-task Learning for Fake News Detection" (arXiv: 1909.01720), answer this question: What architecture does the rest of the multi-task learning setup use?

drafts: The multi-task learning setup uses a shared-private model architecture: a shared-private feature extractor whose "shared" part is a transformer encoder used to encode inputs of both tasks (leveraging its long-range dependencies and parallelism), combined with task-specific "private" parts and a selected sharing layer (attention/gate-based) for stance detection and fake news detection [8] [9] [11].

requirements.reason: 答案准确回答了问题：多任务学习设置采用基于shared-private模型的架构（Figure 2明确说明），并辅以transformer encoder编码两个任务的输入（citation 9、11支持），以及基于门控/注意力机制的selected sharing layer用于stance detection和fake news detection（citation 9支持）。所有断言均有引文支持，无遗漏，无错误。

cited_sources.text: Output Layer Softmax Selected Sharing ⊗ Layer Attention Transformer Shared-private Encoder Feature Extractor Input Embeddings WE Position Embeddings (PE) Task 1: Stance Detection Figure 2: The architecture of the sifted multi-task learning method based on shared-private model. In particular, the two blue boxes represent selected sharing layers of stance detection and fake news detection and the red box denotes shared layer between tasks.

In summary, the contributions of this paper are as follows: • We explore a selected sharing layer relying on gate mechanism and attention mechanism, which can selectively capture valuable shared features between tasks of fake news detection and stance detection for respective tasks. • The transformer encoder is introduced into our model for encoding inputs of both tasks, which enhances the performance of our method by taking advantages of its long-range dependencies and parallelism.

Besides, to better capture long-range dependencies and improve the parallelism of the model, we apply transformer encoder module (Vaswani et al., 2017) to our model for encoding input representations of both tasks. Experimental results reveal that the pro- posed model outperforms the compared methods and gains new benchmarks.
